statements.statement: Papers A and C both discuss end-to-end learning approaches for autonomous driving.
Paper A describes a CNN that learns the entire processing pipeline to steer an automobile, generating steering commands from single center camera images.
Paper C uses CARLA to study end-to-end imitation learning among other approaches, supporting training, prototyping, and validation of autonomous driving models including perception and control.
This theme reflects a shared focus on end-to-end learning methods for autonomous vehicle control.
